note: Synthetic test data from scripts/build_synthetic_data.py, not a delivered source. Segments and targets are derived from data/track_data; keys, types, speeds and timings are fixed defaults.

target_keys.TGT_TYPE: target type, one of the TGT_TYPE values
target_keys.TGT_START_LOC_OFFSET: start offset into that block, feet
target_keys.TGT_START_LOC_DISTID: PTC subdivision/district id of the start block
target_keys.TGT_END_LOC_OFFSET: end offset into that block, feet
target_keys.TGT_END_LOC_DISTID: PTC subdivision/district id of the end block
